$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

board.owner.does: The GitHub user or organisation that owns the story board project.

board.ownerType.does: Whether the board's owner is a user or an organisation.

board.repo.does: The repository whose issues are the board's tickets.

board.projectNumber.does: The number of the GitHub project that is the story board.

board.projectTitle.does: The title of the story board project.

board.statusField.does: The project's field that holds the lane.

board.shared.does: Whether the GitHub board is shared with other teams or repositories (setup then changes nothing that is not this repository's).

board.fields.<field>.does: The project's field names for the pipeline's fields: `impact`, `complexity`, `fixRisk`, `severity`, `confidence`, `reopens`.

board.columns.<lane>.does: The board's column for each pipeline lane: `backlog`, `ready`, `inProgress`, `testing`, `review`, `failed`, `done`.

board.storyLabel.does: The label of a story ticket.

board.epicLabel.does: The label of an epic ticket.

board.spikeLabel.does: The label of a spike ticket.

board.blockedLabel.does: The label of a ticket a person must decide.

board.resolvedLabel.does: The label a person sets when an escalation is resolved.

board.questions.maxQuestions.does: The most questions a failed run's escalation asks a person.

board.questions.timeoutSec.does: The normal time the escalation questions agent may take.

board.questions.logTailChars.does: How much of a failed run's log the escalation questions agent reads.

board.questions.noteChars.does: How much of the escalation notes the escalation questions agent reads.

board.questions.storyChars.does: How much of the ticket the escalation questions agent reads.

board.evidence.playwright.does: The Playwright command board evidence is recorded with (`null`: the repository's).

board.evidence.timeoutSec.does: How long recording a ticket's evidence may take.

board.evidence.maxExchanges.does: The most request and response pairs a ticket's evidence comment shows.

board.evidence.maxBodyChars.does: The most characters of one request or response body in the evidence.

board.evidence.maxCommentChars.does: The most characters of one evidence comment.

board.evidence.extensions.does: The file name endings of the test files board evidence looks through for a ticket's specs.
